invariants.invariant: Exactly two blockchain realization records remain visible: Lottery dApp and Tokenized Voting Backend.
Realisation records remain proof surfaces, not offer-page sections.
Repository contribution is not converted into client outcome, production efficacy or sole-authorship claims.
The final method form remains present and structurally equivalent to the live two-screen qualification flow.
Commercial strengthening may route toward the expertise/programme decision model but must not replace the five-section realization topology.
